title: Suited beings on a scrap-metal train car, 1971

tellings.quote:
And last last night I talked with a lady
who wrote me a letter and she uh for the
first time told anyone outside her
family about something happened in 1971.
in October 1971 and she was uh bicycling
in a small city in the middle of Sweden.

plain: One October evening in 1971, a woman bicycling through a small city in central Sweden says she saw beings in suits on a railway car loaded with scrap metal. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels he spoke with her the night before, after she wrote him a letter, and that it was the first time she had told anyone outside her family.
